question: Calculate the ratio of the average number of bonds per carbon atom in carcinogenic molecules with double bonds to the total count of distinct non-carcinogenic molecules containing single bonds.

    SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_004
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
    INNER JOIN bond b ON a.XCL_002 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
      AND b.XCL_006 = '='
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'c'
),
NonCarcinogenicSingleBondMolecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
      AND b.XCL_006 = '-'
)
SELECT
    CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CarbonBonds) AS REAL) /
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NonCarcinogenicSingleBondMolecules)
    AS ratio

    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.XCL_004) AS bond_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001) AS carbon_count
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
    INNER JOIN bond b ON a.XCL_002 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' 
      AND b.XCL_006 = '=' 
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'c'
),
DenominatorData AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010) AS molecule_count
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-' 
      AND b.XCL_006 = '-'
)
SELECT 
    CAST((SELECT bond_count FROM NumeratorData) AS REAL) / 
    (SELECT carbon_count FROM NumeratorData) /
    (SELECT molecule_count FROM DenominatorData) AS ratio
